generate_coordinated_local_modifications: generate coordinated local order modifications for a Diplomacy power given base actions and a selected location
get_all_possible_orders: get all possible coordinated orders for a given power in the current game state
get_power_per_loc_orders: get a dictionary of possible orders per location for a given power sorted by LOCS index
make_supports_coordinated: replace obviously bad supports and convoys with holds to make an order list coordinated
generate_orders_from_base_strategy_model: generate sampled Diplomacy orders for a power using a trained base strategy model with temperature and top-p
